findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-android_developer" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_rollout, get_pre_submit_status, get_user_permissions, get_app_submission_state, send_app_for_review, get_setup_state, setup_closed_testing · Private data: update_sign_in_details, update_data_safety, send_app_for_review, update_store_settings · Public sink: upload_bundle, start_rollout, update_content_rating, update_data_safety, upload_screenshot_asset, promote_release, get_pre_submit_status, upload_store_listing_graphic, enroll_play_app_signing, get_user_permissions, attach_artifact_to_release, update_track_countries, get_app_submission_state, send_app_for_review, update_store_settings, get_setup_state, setup_closed_testing, submit_prod_access_application · Destructive: update_store_listing_screenshots, upload_store_listing_graphic, grant_app_permission, send_app_for_review, get_setup_state, declare_asset_ai_state, setup_closed_testing, submit_prod_access_application.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_rollout, get_pre_submit_status, get_user_permissions, get_app_submission_state, send_app_for_review, get_setup_state, setup_closed_testing · Private data: update_sign_in_details, update_data_safety, send_app_for_review, update_store_settings · Public sink: upload_bundle, start_rollout, update_content_rating, update_data_safety, upload_screenshot_asset, promote_release, get_pre_submit_status, upload_store_listing_graphic, enroll_play_app_signing, get_user_permissions, attach_artifact_to_release, update_track_countries, get_app_submission_state, send_app_for_review, update_store_settings, get_setup_state, setup_closed_testing, submit_prod_access_application · Destructive: update_store_listing_screenshots, upload_store_listing_graphic, grant_app_permission, send_app_for_review, get_setup_state, declare_asset_ai_state, setup_closed_testing, submit_prod_access_application

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
